aggregation: First compute one throughput and mean-power observation per concurrent batch, then take the median across the fixed prompt, concurrency, and repeat matrix at each requested clock. Prefill throughput counts observed prompt tokens over total request time; decode throughput counts completion tokens over post-first-token time. The modeled CSV keeps the prespecified maximum-cardinality strictly increasing measured subset; the all-requested CSV and raw rows retain every profiled clock.

clock_profile_selection.realized_clock_median_method: one realized-clock observation per phase/prompt/output/concurrency/repeat batch
clock_profile_selection.rule: maximum-cardinality subsequence strictly increasing in batch-balanced median realized clock, prefill rate, and decode rate; ties use the lexicographically earliest requested-clock indices

method: one-second finite-difference least squares on two load/cool cycles
source_label: Measured NVIDIA L4 profile for Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct served by pinned vLLM

sweep_cooldown_protocol.condition_event_metadata: clock, condition index, phase, prompt tokens, output tokens, and concurrency
sweep_cooldown_protocol.stability_rule: consecutive fresh telemetry samples at or below the target
